definitions: A low- to medium-viscosity topical preparation intended for application to unbroken skin.
A washing, especially of the skin for the purpose of beautification.
To cover or treat with a lotion.

blocks.text: Lotion is a low-viscosity topical preparation, typically an emulsion of oil and water, intended for application to unbroken skin for moisturizing, protective, cosmetic, or medicinal purposes. By contrast, creams and gels have higher viscosity, typically due to lower water content. Lotions are applied to external skin with bare hands, a brush, a clean cloth, or cotton wool.
Lotion is an American, Manhattan-based indie rock band, formed in 1991 by brothers Bill and Jim Ferguson, drummer Rob Youngberg, and vocalist/guitarist Tony Zajkowski.

images.alt: Calamine lotion is used to treat itching.
